title: Barcelona day trip
text:
Rita was a very knowledgeable tour host
A truly wonderful and informative day She has a great knowledge of the area and conveys it well
author: Derek_W

title: Rita was in tune with the group
text: Rita was very knowledgeable of the tour and the history. She found us cover from the rain and was very flexible!  Definitely recommend!
author: TIMOTHY_B

title: Pleasant experience
text: Very good way to get to know old Barcelona, Tarek was very patient with the children and all the info he gave us was very enriching
author: Estela_P

title: Fabiola is an exceptional...
text: Fabiola is an exceptional guide; knowledgeable, professional and very friendly.  Her tour in spanish was impeccable!  Your visit in Barcelona will only be completed after you've walked the streets and immerse yourself in the local history and vibe. 100% recommended!
author: Carlos_R
